title: Battle of Harnaulgarh
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Harnaulgarh", at revision 1370265394, opens: "The Battle of Harnaulgarh was fought between the Durrani Empire and the Sikh Misls of Dal Khalsa in 1762." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q28174194, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1762 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
regionNote: Lane written by the Wikidata import (derived from its own point): this event points at no place record, so the timeline has nothing else to go on.
